name: Meditation Skill Routine
description: Deterministic four-week meditation skill routine starting 2026-06-29. Build attention stability and reduce the stickiness of repetitive verbal thought loops, especially adversarial argument rehearsal.

payload.instructions: Count each exhale from 1 to 10. When attention drifts or the count is lost, restart at 1 without self-criticism. Anchor: exhale count. Success condition: Not staying perfectly focused, but noticing drift and returning cleanly. Failure modes: trying to suppress thoughts, turning lost count into frustration, mechanically counting while thinking in the background.

card_templates.name: Focused Attention — Raw Anchor
card_templates.summary: Focused attention using direct breath or body sensation without counting.

payload.instructions: Rest attention on one physical anchor. When attention drifts, notice the drift and return to the anchor. Do not use counting unless attention becomes too unstable. Anchor: breath sensation or body contact. Fallback: Use exhale counting for 1-3 minutes if attention becomes too scattered. Success condition: Earlier detection of distraction and smoother return to the anchor.

card_templates.name: Open Monitoring — Noting
card_templates.summary: Open awareness practice with light labels for thoughts, sensations, and emotional charge.

payload.instructions: Notice sensations, sounds, thoughts, and emotions without following them. Use short labels when content becomes sticky, then return to open awareness. Anchor: open field of present-moment experience. Fallback anchor: body contact. Default labels: thinking, planning, arguing, rehearsing, remembering, judging, emotion, body, sound. Priority label: arguing. Success condition: The argument may appear, but you do not complete it. Failure modes: daydreaming and calling it open awareness, analyzing why a thought appeared, finishing the imaginary argument before returning.

card_templates.name: Meditation Weekly Review
card_templates.summary: Brief weekly review of attention stability, thought stickiness, and argument-loop reduction.

payload.instructions: Review the last week without moralizing. Identify which practice most reduced argument-loop stickiness and which context triggered the most rumination.

items.label: Which practice made it easiest to notice thought loops early?
Did argument loops feel less sticky this week?
What was the most common trigger?
What should stay unchanged next week?

routine_specs.name: Meditation Skill Routine
routine_specs.notes:
Purpose: Build attention stability and reduce the stickiness of repetitive verbal thought loops, especially adversarial argument rehearsal.

Goals: attention_stability: Improve ability to place attention on an anchor, notice distraction, and return without escalation. thought_defusion: Notice thoughts as events in awareness rather than arguments that must be completed. argument_loop_reduction: Reduce frequency, duration, and emotional charge of internal adversarial dialogue. deliberate_planning_boundary: Separate intentional planning from rumination, rehearsal, and imaginary debate.

Progression: increase_duration_slowly: increase session duration gradually across the four weeks. reduce_scaffolding: move from counting toward raw-anchor attention when stable. label_only_when_needed: use noting labels only when attention is captured. do_not_chase_blank_mind: train recognition and return rather than suppressing thought. argument_loop_is_primary_target: judge transfer by whether adversarial thought loops become easier to interrupt.

Completion criteria: minimum_adherence: Complete at least 20 of 28 assigned days. focused_attention_exposure: Complete at least 8 focused-attention sessions. open_monitoring_exposure: Complete at least 8 open-monitoring sessions. review_completion: Complete at least 3 of 4 weekly reviews.

After four weeks: focused_attention_improves_attention_but_not_argument_loops: Keep focused attention as support practice 2x/week and make open monitoring/noting the main practice. open_monitoring_reduces_argument_stickiness: Progress open monitoring to 25 minutes and add more running-transfer sessions. both_practices_help: Use alternating schedule: focused attention on high-distraction days, open monitoring on rumination-heavy days. neither_practice_reduces_argument_loops: Add stronger cognitive boundary protocol: scheduled planning windows, written argument parking lot, and run-specific noting.
